purpose: retrospective historical DC usable-quantity proxy compared with one later published controlled test
design_status: exploratory; published reference and full-month quality already inspected; no blind confirmation

source.metadata_status: publisher-gathered, not guaranteed exact physical bounds

reference.status: author-reported controlled field DC usable quantities; shared measurement chain, not VPP commitment truth
reference.numbers_role: labels only, not used to pick history, anchors or candidate intervals

information.embargo_basis: conservative engineering assumption inspired by author average preparation/test/follow-up of about two days; actual prep onset unknown
information.available_time_assumption: all included native rows are retrospectively available by history cutoff; no actual reception logs
information.timezone: native source strings only; absolute timezone not assumed
information.isolation: rows at or after cutoff, including test/preparation, excluded from feature computation; labels joined after selection

rest_proxy.anchor: first confirmation row: start+299 native seconds, median voltage of last 60 rows divided by 40
rest_proxy.maximal_runs: contiguous finite non-interpolated rows with abs(I)<=0.15; use only first confirmation per run

roles.current_threshold: 0.01C of nominal 15Ah, within publisher candidate range; fixed engineering choice
roles.duration: publisher says several minutes; 300s is fixed engineering choice, no fitted OCV
roles.high_threshold: publisher describes S_LMO EOC relaxation region above 4.1V; proxy not proof of full SOC
roles.low_threshold: 3.5V is explicit engineering low-voltage proxy, not manufacturer EOD or proven SOC=0
roles.tail_median: noise-resistant recorded-voltage proxy; not fitted equilibrium OCV

pairing.rule: scan anchors chronologically; latest high anchor becomes open start, middle anchors leave it open; each low consumes that start even if resulting interval fails; no repeated low reuse
pairing.integration: left rectangle on native timestamps [high_anchor, low_anchor); low_anchor is needed to confirm terminal state and is excluded from integral
pairing.quality: all rows from high through low anchor inclusive are finite, native consecutive seconds, Interpolated=0; no added interpolation or lag correction
pairing.sign_requirement: net measured Ah and UI energy strictly positive; any charging inside interval retained and reported
pairing.missing_start: low anchor with no preceding high is recorded, never invented
pairing.selection: latest eligible low-anchor available before cutoff; deterministic ties by high-anchor; no selection by reference proximity
pairing.fallback: if no candidate qualifies, feature remains unavailable; no nominal fill or exclusion of target test

sample.unit: one controlled field test event, not seconds or historical intervals
sample.split: single retrospective evaluation; no train, no validation, no parameter fitting

changes: do not revise thresholds, embargo or pairing after reference comparison; changes require new protocol and disclosure
